versions.changelog: Ground every pitch in supplied or sourced proof; replace unsupported customer, metric, integration, implementation, and competitor claims with placeholders.

- Added multilingual keywords and translated descriptions to support international and non-English users.
- Expanded the skill description to include common terms for booth scripts in Chinese, German, Japanese, and Spanish.
- No changes to workflow or script generation logic; documentation update only.
Sharpened skill descriptions and first-screen README summaries for clearer ClawHub discovery, faster fit assessment, and stronger install intent.
Workflow and handoff refinements across pre-show, on-site, and post-show skills. Improved trigger boundaries, decision-oriented outputs, and cross-skill next-step guidance.

Initial release of booth-script-generator.

- Generates tailored trade show booth scripts based on visitor type: cold walk-up, warm lead, competitor’s customer, and current customer.
- Separates each visitor path with custom opening lines, pitches, qualification questions, and CTAs.
- Includes a printable Quick Reference Card summarizing key scripts and signals for easy staff use.
- Requires minimal input; fills gaps with default scripts and offers to expand based on user needs.
- Ensures quality by specifying script length, open-ended qualification questions, and regulated industry compliance flag.
